items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: He had a Chinese fellow that Valaida Snow had taught how to cook American. Valaida had been over there before us.

ctx.x: This was not Japanese, this was Chinese?
This was Chinese against criminals, Chinese criminals. That's something. Strange you know.
Yes, I never did want to see it. I couldn't, I didn't even like to look at the pictures I saw of it.
